@Ruth, I haven't set up the daily brief yet. My scheduler can't connect to the Gateway: every automation call fails with "gateway cron requires credentials", so I couldn't create the 07:45 job or check for an existing one. Nothing will post tomorrow until that's fixed. Once an operator restores the Gateway credentials, I can set it up. I haven't posted anything here.

When I set it up, the brief would:
- Run at 07:45 Chicago time each morning, starting Thursday 15 October.
- Post in this channel only.
- Cover #strategic-pod, #strategic-random and #inc-vtg-hartford. Everyone in this channel (you, Gideon and Nadia) is in all three, so nobody would see anything they can't already see. If membership changes, a channel is skipped.
- Leave out finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms). It would say "finance detail omitted" and point to June or Anselm. Seat counts, renewal dates, tickets and meeting times would still appear.
- Leave out direct messages.
